name: DC2 official sources, second batch (Gulf)
policy: Every name, link and status appears verbatim in its captured document; capacities go through the versioned extractor. USGS 2024 facilities tables give the unit t without a period; as in batch 1 the yearbook year is used: period = calendar 2024. USGS lists major equity owners of the operating company; those are recorded as owners of the plant, valid for 2024 only.
to_confirm: USGS 2024 facilities tables have no table title with a year (only the page header 'BAHRAIN—2024' and the cover '2024 Minerals Yearbook'); capacities and owner links are read as calendar 2024
Values marked 'e' (USGS estimate), e.g. Alba 1,620,000e t, are kept as capacities, as with the 'Annual capacity e' column in batch 1 (Australia 2023)

Company countries from the name or legal form: Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Co. (BH), Saudi Arabian Mining Co. (Ma'aden) (SA), Qatar Aluminium Manufacturing Co. Q.P.S.C. (QA), Abu Dhabi National Energy Co. P.J.S.C. (AE), OQ S.A.O.C. (OM), Aluminium Bahrain B.S.C. (BH), Qatar Aluminium Ltd. Q.S.C. (QA)

Ownership change: the Alcoa 10-K for 2025 says Alcoa sold its 25.1% in MBAC and MAC to Ma'aden on 2025-07-01; USGS names the holder as Alcoa Saudi Smelting Inversiones S.L., which the 10-K does not name. Not recorded as a fact; owner links here end on 2024-12-31
